description: Export private XPmetric measured-landing evidence for a server milestone producer. Defaults to v1; opt into v2 for a SHA-256 proof of the currently stored eligible measured population at the requested cutoff. The proof does not establish total browser delivery or an ingestion watermark. Owned cookie-tracked site only. Returns each browser's exact first eligible measured landing since experiment launch, then filters the inclusive UTC period. Maximum 90 days from launch and 100,000 measured session entries; excess or query failure is an error, never truncated evidence. Contains browser hashes: keep private and do not paste into public logs. This proves measured arrivals, not account activation or complete consent coverage.
name: get_experiment_landings
